disconnected.starting: Backend is starting… {{seconds}} s. The first start after an installation or an update loads the scientific libraries and can take a minute or two.
disconnected.lost: Connection to the backend lost — reconnecting…
disconnected.message: Backend not connected — it did not answer within 3 minutes. Close Orienta completely and start it again; if this repeats, use Settings → Report a problem (the report contains logs/backend-console.log with the reason).

hoverTips.errorTryAgain: Dismiss the error and try re-mounting this module without reloading the app
hoverTips.errorReload: Reload the entire application in the browser
hoverTips.devLogFilter: Filter log entries by this category
hoverTips.fileSwitcher: Switch the active loaded file — reloads it on the backend and refreshes all pages
